inputs.original_text: DSD athletes also face exclusion from future Olympics IOC says move will protect fairness and safety’ The International Olympic Committee has banned transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category of events at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games in a landmark decision. Kirsty Coventry, president of the IOC, said: “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category.” Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text: The IOC calls it “fairness and safety,” but that looks like cover for deciding who is allowed to belong. The ban on transgender women and DSD athletes in the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games gives the institution power to define the category, then presents that power as neutral science. Coventry’s claim — “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category” — shuts down debate and makes exclusion sound inevitable. This doesn’t prove the decision is only about fairness; it’s a warning about who gets to set the rules.
